title: Propagation search machine
statement: Let $q$ be a positive number of labels, let a family of encoded Unique Games instances be given, and let a propagation optimization encoding for that family be fixed. A propagation search machine consists of a polynomial-time map from bit-list inputs to bit-list outputs such that, on every canonical instance encoding, its output is the encoding of that instance's propagation assignment.
hypotheses_covered: The label set $	ext{Fin}(q)$ is nonempty
A propagation optimization encoding for the family
caveat: The supplied snippet omits the definition of the propagation assignment.
